nodes.label: 16px Floor on Main Reading Content
nodes.summary: productCardName, productCardPrice, and categoryCaption are locked to text-base (16px minimum) across all Ebda Store themes. Below-16px breaks iOS Safari auto-zoom, cramps Arabic diacritics on mobile, and violates WCAG 1.4.4 readability.

nodes.label: Theme Identity Carried by Weight/Tracking/Family, Not Size
nodes.summary: No Ebda Store theme may shrink main reading text below 16px to achieve a distinctive look. Identity differentiators are font-weight, letter-spacing, font-family, and border-radius — not size reduction.

nodes.label: design.md as Canonical Typography Size Table
nodes.summary: The repo-root design.md holds the authoritative per-zone fontSize table. Every pack-styles.ts token must match the corresponding row; any intentional deviation requires an inline comment with a justification.

nodes.label: Per-Theme Typography Identity Carriers
nodes.summary: Each of the five Ebda Store themes (modern, classic, minimal, bold, elegant) differentiates via weight+tracking+family combinations: e.g. elegant = font-extralight + tracking-[0.22-0.32em] + hairline borders; bold = font-black uppercase + tracking-tight + brutalist borders. Size stays uniform.

nodes.label: pack-styles.ts Audit Recipe
nodes.summary: Before adding or modifying any theme pack, run grep -E 'text-(\[11px\]|xs|sm|base|lg|xl)' on pack-styles.ts and cross-check every hit against the design.md size table. Any divergence must have a code comment explaining the exception.

nodes.label: CTA and seeAll Links Standardized at 14px
nodes.summary: productCardCta and sectionSeeAll are fixed at text-sm (14px) across all five themes, resolving previous drift that ranged from text-xs (12px) to text-[11px] to text-sm depending on the theme.

nodes.label: Typography Anti-Patterns (Size Drift)
nodes.summary: Four anti-patterns: (1) new theme sets productCardName to text-sm 'for elegance'; (2) seeAll shrunk to text-xs as 'secondary'; (3) price bumped above text-base 'for prominence'; (4) editing pack-styles.ts without consulting design.md first. All cause accidental inter-theme drift.

nodes.label: Context-Aware Brand Color Token Resolution
nodes.summary: resolveColorValue(v, context) auto-swaps surface tokens to their foreground pairs when context='text', preventing white-on-white or black-on-black. brand-muted as text → --muted-foreground; brand-foreground as background → --background.

nodes.label: Semantic Surface/Foreground Token Pairing
nodes.summary: Every design-system surface color (--muted, --primary, --secondary, --accent, --background) has a foreground counterpart (--muted-foreground, --primary-foreground, etc.). The context resolver bridges merchant intent ('brand-muted means gray text') vs literal CSS var ('--muted is the light-gray surface').

nodes.label: Three-Layer Token Lock-Step (Emitter + Preview + Picker)
nodes.summary: Context-aware resolution must stay in sync across three callsites: (1) storefront CSS emitter in apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx, (2) admin live preview helper (cfgToInlineStyle / resolveColorForPreview), (3) admin color picker swatches. If any layer diverges, merchants see one color in the picker and a different one on the live storefront.

nodes.label: Store Token String, Resolve at Render
nodes.summary: Color fields must persist the semantic token string ('brand-muted') rather than the resolved hex value. This preserves the brand-link: when a merchant updates their brand color in Branding, every typography zone using a preset auto-updates without manual re-selection.

nodes.label: Brand-Link Preservation Principle
nodes.summary: Storing tokens instead of hex values means a single Branding page update cascades to every zone that uses a preset — section headings, product names, CTAs, decorations — without the merchant needing to touch each field individually.

nodes.label: Context-Aware Token Anti-Patterns
nodes.summary: Three anti-patterns: (1) new brand token added without auditing both text+background semantics; (2) new color-using field added without passing the context flag (silently defaults to 'background', breaks text fields); (3) resolved hex stored on save (breaks brand-link when merchant changes palette).

nodes.label: Color Token Verification Recipe
nodes.summary: Four-step verification: pick surface token on text field → swatch shows muted-text color; pick on background field → swatch shows surface color; save+reload storefront → matches preview; change brand color in Branding → both fields auto-update. Any step failing points to a specific out-of-sync layer.

nodes.label: brand-muted Text-Context Auto-Flip to --muted-foreground
nodes.summary: When a merchant selects brand-muted in a text-color slot, the resolver returns hsl(var(--muted-foreground)) instead of hsl(var(--muted)). This is the canonical example of the surface→foreground bridge: the merchant says 'muted' and gets legible gray text, not invisible near-white.
